title_draft: Zad Archery Mega Update (Sep 4): Symbols, Rings, Preferred Job and Endless
quick_answer_draft: The September 4 Mega Update is the current major content jump after launch. It adds the Symbol System (50+ Symbols and Exalted Symbols), Preferred Job, the Ring System with Portal Currency after level 30 and 9 Ring perks, Endless farming, and removes the Level 50 cap. September 5 Patch 1.1.1 is the follow-up stability patch.

claims.text: Symbol System added, including 50+ Symbols and Exalted Symbols.
Preferred Job added; it doubles all bonuses of the preferred job.
Ring System added, with Portal Currency used after level 30 and 9 Ring perks.
Automatic currency pickup and progression behavior improved.
Use the Symbols and Rings / Portal Currency / Endless guides for system overviews without unverified rankings.
Read Patch 1.1.1 for Guardian skip recovery and related stability fixes.

faq.q: Is the Mega Update the current major version?
faq.a: Yes for major content systems. Patch 1.1.1 is the next-day follow-up patch on top of it.

faq.q: Did the Mega Update remove the Level 50 cap?
faq.a: Yes. Official notes confirm the Level 50 cap was removed and Endless farming was added.

codex_rule: Only publish verified Mega Update facts. No Symbol/Ring ranking pages from this source alone.
